name: Shortlist (save or skip a stack of candidates)
use_when: several listings or candidates to go through one by one: sublets, apartments, couches, used cars, venues
'shortlist', 'swipe through these', 'save the ones you like', 'narrow down the listings'
each person saves or skips every candidate on their own, and the group sees which ones got the most saves
dont_use_when: the group picks one option by vote (use poll)
knocking options out until one is left (use veto)
guarantees: each person has one answer per candidate, save or skip; answering again changes it
where you are in the stack comes from your answers, the same on every device
the shortlist ranks by saves, ties in the order the candidates were posted
the candidates never change; a leaver's answers go, a late joiner gets the whole stack
